tie_break_derivation: Both targets are at 105, so Design section 12, "the full quantity at stop"'s long-ascending-price key ties. The declared secondary key is exit_id UTF-8 byte order. Common prefix 'TARGET-' (bytes 54 41 52 47 45 54 2D); the next byte is 0x46 ('F') for TARGET-FAR and 0x4e ('N') for TARGET-NEAR; 0x46 < 0x4e, so TARGET-FAR orders first. Design section 12, "the full quantity at stop" states this same result.

In-window ledger: FEE(F0) -0.04725, GROSS(F0) +5, FEE(F1) -0.04725, GROSS(F1) +5. The pre-window entry fill at 2000-01-01T00:11:00Z charged its own ENTRY fee of 0.09 (fee_notional 100 * 2 * 1), so equity_curve.first = 1000 - 0.09 = 999.91 and equity_curve.last = 999.91 - 0.04725 + 5 - 0.04725 + 5 = 1009.8155.
